title: Figure of an Odalisque
artist_note: Inspired by a model by James Pradier; not attributed to Pradier or Pajou by the auction catalogue.
dimensions: 71.7 cm high × 58.5 cm wide; depth unrecorded
description: A seated woman turns toward the viewer, one hand lifting her headdress. Drapery gathers across her lap and the rocky seat. This anonymous nineteenth-century marble was inspired by James Pradier’s Odalisque, a composition associated with Romantic Orientalism.
date_caution: 1841 refers to Pradier’s Salon version, not a documented creation date for this object.
scan_license_verification: Root agent independently verified CC0 in the MyMiniFactory browser listing and downloaded through its Download Only control.
attribution: Figure of an Odalisque, unknown French or Italian sculptor, second quarter of the 19th century, white marble. Formerly offered at Christie’s, New York, 29 October 2019, lot 793. 3D scan by Jadyn N. Marshall (Janim), via MyMiniFactory, CC0 1.0; processed by Atrium.
artwork_rights: Historical anonymous sculpture dated to the second quarter of the nineteenth century; public-domain assessment. Separate scan CC0 dedication confirmed by root.
